A '''plasma jet''', also known as a '''Plasma Burrowing Jet''', was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tool mounted on the [[11-17-series mining droid]]. It produced a superheated beam of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] for burrowing through rock. The jet's beam could be modified in size, ranging from a needlepoint discharge all the way up to a half-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] low-intensity cone.<ref name="EGTD" />

Over the course of a few months [[Fy-Tor-Ana|Solace]] found parts and built a small two-person craft that resembled an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] with a plasma jet in place of where the nose would be, making the nose appear cut off. Alongside [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Trever Flume]], Solace and the other two used the craft and plasma jet to break into the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="LOTJ:U">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref>
